label: json-error-split-fallback
description: Shapes where the JSON error-filter split falls back to the row evaluator (more than twice -max-stats-query-series groups): main vs branch warm p50 (3-5 runs, distinct windows), host proxies against one VictoriaLogs v1.52.0 stack, restarts 0->0. The fallback costs one VictoriaLogs stats scan on top of main's row evaluator; where main's row evaluator fails fast with the series limit error (F1, F2) the branch is slower by that scan.
command: python3 optj4-fallback.py <vl_port> <range_seconds> <runs> 120 <ports> (host proxies with the shown -max-stats-query-series, a client timeout of 120 s)

rows.shape: F1 sum by (session_id), groups past twice the limit
F2 sum by (service_name), 7 groups past twice the limit
F4 sum by (detected_level), 11 level spellings (12 groups, 5 series)
F3 sum by (user_id), groups within twice the limit (no fallback)
F1 sum by (session_id), groups past twice the limit
F2 sum by (service_name), 7 groups past twice the limit
F4 sum by (detected_level), 11 level spellings (12 groups, 5 series)
F3 sum by (user_id), groups within twice the limit (no fallback)
